name: competitor-alternatives
description:
When the user wants to create competitor comparison or alternative pages for SEO
and sales enablement. Also use when the user mentions "alternative page," "vs
page," "competitor comparison," "comparison page," "[Product] vs [Product],"
"[Product] alternative," or "competitive landing pages." Covers four formats:
singular alternative, plural alternatives, you vs competitor, and competitor vs
competitor. Emphasizes deep research, modular content architecture, and varied
section types beyond feature tables.
